title: RACE
slogan: NO LAYUPS, 3s OR FOULS IN FIRST 6 SECONDS

terms.name: PACE 21
terms.description: Get the ball transported across half court by 21 seconds on shot clock — either thru breakout dribble or throw ahead,

terms.name: SPOTS - All players sprint to the 5 spots
terms.description: Deep Corners-Wings—& Post (either Big Ahead into Dunker or Big Above the 3 as a Trailer) in 5 sec or less

terms.name: DUNKER
terms.description: Short corner - “heels on the baseline” - outside the hash mark - wide and flat - opposite the ball for O5

terms.name: THROW AHEAD
terms.description: Look to advance the ball with the pass. Create early numbers advantages.

terms.name: DEEP OUTLET
terms.description: Guard Gets butt to the Sideline - Free Throw-Line Extended. First sneak a peek to see numbers before receiving pass.

terms.name: CLOSEST MAN INBOUNDS
terms.description: If 5 man inbounds, he will trail and we will be 5 Out Big Above. If anyone else inbounds = Big Ahead and 4 Out  Spacing

terms.name: 77 -Double Drag
terms.description: Staggered ball screen - O5 Screens second.

title: CORE
slogan: TRIGGERS IF WE ARE NEUTRALIZED ‘SECONDARY BREAKS
pillars: ★ " MOTION" OR FINGER TWIRL = CONTINUOUS BALLSCREEN

terms.name: NEUTRALIZED
terms.description: If the defense has all 5 players back- they are loaded to the ball - and the on ball defender is square without a foot angle  advantage. If no advantage = neutralized. We would then flow into a Trigger to create action.

terms.name: TRIGGER
terms.description: Screening action — one of our Core 5 Calls. Triggers incorporate O5 to get a ballhandler downhill and to but defense in the  blender.

terms.name: BIG AHEAD
terms.description: When the O5 is ahead of the ball and rim runs. If he does not get ball early, he spaces to opposite dunker and we initiate “4”  series for 4 out 1 in spacing.

terms.name: BIG ABOVE
terms.description: When the O5 is above the 3 point line or “trailing” the play. We would initiate any one of our 5-Out Triggers— Handler calls it.

terms.name: EARLY CALL
terms.description: PG or handler identities 4 out or 5 Out Spacing, if we are neutralized with no advantage, and makes a call for a Core 5 Trigger.

terms.name: BREAK THE PAINT
terms.description: Any time we enter the paint with a drive or a pass to a cutter or post man - ENGAGE 2 DEFENDERS!

terms.name: SCRAMBLE
terms.description: Our term for when we force the other team into full rotation by making their LOW MAN help at the RIM forcing a double team.

terms.name: E2
terms.description: Stands for engage 2. When this happen, we must look and pass to open teammate

terms.name: DRIVE KICK SWING
terms.description: When we drive the paint - then kick out and make a quick swing to punish rotation — the “Extra Pass”.

terms.name: KICK OUT GET OUT
terms.description: If you drive to the paint, and kick out, you must sprint and exit cut faster than you entered. Creates space for next drive.

terms.name: FOLLOW YOUR MOMENTUM
terms.description: When you break the paint and cross the nail, and you kick out, follow the momentum of your pass to relocate.
Stands for 1/2 a second. Once you have the defense on the run, make quick decisions to shoot, drive or pass - do not let the ball stick.

terms.name: 1ST SIDE
terms.description: The side of the floor where the initial trigger is initiated. O5 usually rolls off the trigger to the basket and spaces to opposite  dunker.

terms.name: 2ND SIDE
terms.description: Any time the ball crosses the midline with a pass after the initial 1st side action. O5 stays spaced to opposite dunker and we run a  2-man game with the players on that side of the floor.

terms.name: GHOST
terms.description: Whenever we “ghost screen”, a player without the ball sprints up to set a screen but slips to the 3 PT LINE without making  contact

terms.name: SLIP
terms.description: Whenever we “ghost screen”, a player without the ball sprints up to set a screen but slips to the RIM without making contact

terms.name: GET
terms.description: The Shooter’s Pick N Roll” When player with the ball throws to the 05 and sprints off for a handback

terms.name: RIFLE
terms.description: Weakside action when we have O4 or O5 in weakside corner — he flashes out of the corner for Get Game with the Small in slot.

terms.name: 3RD SIDE
terms.description: If the ball does not break the paint or we get neutralized on 2nd side, we swing it to the 3rd side into Flash or Snap Action.

terms.name: SNAP - Slot Step Up Screen
terms.description: Angle PNR WIth Corners filled. Big Sprints up from the dunker as the ball leaves fingertips of 2nd side  passer.

terms.name: FLASH (HAND FLASHING 0-5)- When the big flashes up from the dunker on the 3rd side to create action with Split Games
terms.description: either Hi Splits or Low Splits.

terms.name: ACTION TAGS
terms.description: Tag words we add to the end of a play Family to create variety quickly on demand to create new advantages or punish  coverages.

terms.name: SIDE
terms.description: Move the trigger to a wing ( Side horns, Side Fist)

terms.name: TOUCH
terms.description: Whenever we throw the ball to another small (1-4) and look to flip it back to the original passer to get downhill & create  separation.

terms.name: C
terms.description: Whenever we curl a two-man game, we tag it with a C. Examples include Away C, 5 C Point C.- Whoever we curl off, flashes back to  ball.

terms.name: TWIST
terms.description: Whenever we re-screen to counter the defense going under the screen.

terms.name: ROCKET - Our tag for Spain PNR
terms.description: Where shooter O2 sets a backscreen for 05 right after a 15 PNR.

terms.name: CASH - our term for a backdoor cut
terms.description: a Cash Cut— vs overplay. If defense is flat, we face cut. If defense is up the line, we backcut.

terms.name: COLOR
terms.description: any color = a rescreen or QUICK ACTION where O5 sets a pin down rescreen

terms.name: CLEAR
terms.description: if we clear out the weakside corner to open up lob and single side tag.

terms.name: EXIT  OR KLAY ACTION
terms.description: Strongside baseline pin screen while PNR takes place to distort and eliminate a loaded side of tags. Named for Klay Thompson.

terms.name: UP
terms.description: Up screen that leads screen receiver towards the screen

terms.name: DOWN
terms.description: Down screen that leads screen receiver away from closest baseline

terms.name: MIAMI
terms.description: Weakside Rip Slip with a shooter followed by a Quick screen From 5.

terms.name: HAMMER
terms.description: Weakside flare screen and slip from the corner to slot while a baseline drive takes place on strong side.

terms.name: 4 POINT LINE SPACING
terms.description: In the HIgh Quad or Slot - Space 3 feet behind the FIBA 3 point line to create a longer closeout for Nail Defender.

terms.name: STAMPEDE GO
terms.description: If receiver catches on the run and rips thru opposite of his defender to punish heavy nail or heavy corner shrink by puncturing the gap created by over help.

terms.name: RUN THRU - If receiver catches on the run and face cuts the defender
terms.description: if defense is closing out on low shoulder.

terms.name: SIDE STEP 3 - If shooter gets run off the line
terms.description: side dribble to create a new window to shoot a 3 instead of settling for a long 2

terms.name: DRIFT
terms.description: When the ball drives toward you, drift away to create more space and a longer closeout for your defender.

terms.name: DRAG
terms.description: When the ball drives away from you, you drag behind the penatrator.

terms.name: DIVE
terms.description: When you see the back of your defender, you dive to the basket (cut)

terms.name: CIRCLE CUT
terms.description: Weakside 5 in the "DUNKER" , circle cuts around the rim to create space for a rim drive towards him

terms.name: I CUT
terms.description: Strong side 5 in the "DUNKER:, "I CUTS" up to create space for a rim drive towards him

title: PICK AND ROLL READS
pillars: ★ SEARCH = IF E2, LOOK FOR ROLL OR POP
★ SKIP = PUNISH TAGS WITH SKIP PASSES

terms.name: SPRINT TO SCREEN
terms.description: Screeners create separation by sprinting to screen.. “Arrive Alone

terms.name: SCREEN LOWER 1/3
terms.description: Make sure you force the over by screening the lower 1/3 of the defenders body. “Force The Over

terms.name: TOUCH N GO HOT STOVE
terms.description: Release and sprint out of the screen after setting it to create a 2-on-1 to the basket. - Go once ballhandling defender turns hip ( not squared anymore)

terms.name: ROLLER BEHIND MENTALITY
terms.description: Big “looks to get to the rim to force a 2-on-1.

terms.name: SCORE
terms.description: Handler looks to come off the screen looking to get downhill or punish the under if they are a great shooter. “SCORE

terms.name: SEARCH
terms.description: As the ball handler Engages 2 Defenders, he looks for the roll or pop man. “SEARCH FOR SCREENER

terms.name: SKIP
terms.description: If perimeter defenders pull in to tag and help on roller, the handler looks to skip it to the perimeter receiver's man who helps.

terms.name: HOSTAGE
terms.description: Holding defender behind you after accepting the ball screen.

terms.name: HANG
terms.description: Using a float dribble to engage X5 until O5 gets behing X5

terms.name: GORTAT
terms.description: Used vs deep drop. Guard hostage dribble & holds X1 on back while O5 sprints ahead & seals X5. O1 snakes for rim finish.

terms.name: ENGAGE BIG
terms.description: Guards job is to engage the big by forcing him to displace himself from O5 to create an early pocket pass window.

terms.name: TWIST
terms.description: Our term for re-screening if the defense goes under.

terms.name: RACE THE UNDER
terms.description: Ballhandler still turns the corner with force and beats his defender to the paint and gets to his body downhill.

terms.name: SLIP ROLL
terms.description: Screener dives to the rim when his man calls the ice. Handler looks to hit him for lob or pocket.

terms.name: TWIST THE SCREEN
terms.description: Screener flips the screen into step up. Handler looks to snake to the middle. Good for great shooter vs Drop

terms.name: GET GAME
terms.description: O5 pops - and ball handler throws it to popping big and flies off it for hardback going over the top to the middle.

terms.name: RACE THE SWITCH
terms.description: Attack a soft switch by racing it downhill to the basket.

terms.name: CUTBACK AKA DRIVE THE WAKE
terms.description: Cutback vs Hard Switch and look to attack the foot angle of the hard switch by rejecting it to the paint

terms.name: SLIP ROLL
terms.description: When screener reads switch and your defender is at the level, slip roll to the rim to get behind the defense.

terms.name: BOOMERANG
terms.description: Ballhandler immediately reverses the ball on switch, backs up 3 steps, creates a runway for catch n go on pass back.

terms.name: MOUSE IN THE HOUSE
terms.description: After a switch having a small defender on our Big in the post

terms.name: MOOSE ON THE LOOSE
terms.description: After a switch having a big defender on our Guard in the perimeter

terms.name: 4 S PASSES - Short roll, Shake (drag pass), See ( Reversal pass to the player your dribbling towards), Skip ( opposite corner)
terms.description: > Get behind the trap & find window to pass

terms.name: ADVANCE IT
terms.description: Use a Flow Pass and then look to break the paint after the ball leaves the trap

terms.name: SCORE-SEARCH-SKIP
terms.description: Reads for the Short Roll Man in the pocket. Score first, Search for Cutters - Skip Opposite for 3 If they  collapse

terms.name: NASH IT
terms.description: Handler keeps his dribble and draws the big out along the baseline out to the corner and can boomerang from there.

terms.name: WARRIOR
terms.description: Nash the ball out to the corner, then pass it to the wing and get it back to attack the X5 off boomerang in corner.

terms.name: UNDER
terms.description: Race The Under or Twist.

terms.name: CASH
terms.description: Backcut if the defender ever plays on the top side when you are receiving a DHO

terms.name: CHASE
terms.description: Get downhill and break the paint or SPACE Out 3s for shooters

terms.name: SWITCH
terms.description: Race The Switch or DRIVE THE WAKE vs Hard Switch

terms.name: BLITZ
terms.description: Quick Pocket pass or Advance it

terms.name: MOOSE
terms.description: Term for weakest defenders. Players and matchups we want to target.

terms.name: 4:1 SPACING
terms.description: Ball In Slot with Mismatch we want to target. Corners Filled. Big in dunker to create Double Gap for Handler to attack.

terms.name: DOUBLE GAP��
terms.description: When we move an offensive player & the nearest gap defender to create more space for the handler to create

terms.name: BREAK THE PAINT
terms.description: Force the defense into the BLENDER. Force rotation and Engage 2 defenders - Drive and Kick to create great shots.

terms.name: BOOMERANG
terms.description: Ballhandler immediately reverses the ball on the switch, backs up 3 steps, creates a runway for catch n go on pass back

terms.name: HI SPLITS
terms.description: 2-Man Game that takes place in the High Quad. Great to create downhill drives with uphill DHO and punish switches

terms.name: LOW SPLITS
terms.description: 2-Man Game that takes place in Corners to create a double gap for the handler to get over top & create low angle PNR.

terms.name: C
terms.description: Any time we tag the split game with “C” it means that the cutter in the 2-,man game CURLS to basket bringing screener back to ball.

terms.name: I GO
terms.description: I go to the rim during split game

terms.name: YOU GO
terms.description: You go to the rim during split game

terms.name: YES
terms.description: I accept the screen during split game

terms.name: TWIRL
terms.description: Like a pigs tail, receiver sling to screen screener's defender

terms.name: SPEED CUT
terms.description: Post feeder sprints baseline side of post feed and cuts to basket and then opposite corner.

terms.name: CATCH-CHIN-CHECK
terms.description: When post catches it: Catch on Two Feet with 2 Hands. Chin the basketball. Check over inside shoulder for  cutters.

terms.name: SCORE-SEARCH-SKIP
terms.description: Reads for post player. Score first, Search for Cutters - Skip Opposite for 3 If they Collapse

terms.name: SPLIT GAMES
terms.description: Post Feeder initiates a 2-man games with the nearest perimeter offensive player.
